speaker: Doctor
text:
I see you are presenting with fatigue, abdominal pain, night sweats, weight loss, and enlarged supraclavicular lymph nodes. These are concerning systemic symptoms; have you noticed any changes in your bowel habits or stool color recently?

REQUEST TEST: CBC with differential, LFTs, LDH, ESR, CRP.
REQUEST TEST: CT Abdomen and Pelvis with contrast.

DIAGNOSIS READY: [Pending initial lab and imaging results to confirm suspected malignancy, likely lymphoma or metastatic carcinoma.]
